method: Interactive in-app browser against the local production frontend and real API/worker
input: Generated public FASTA fixture LLLLLLLLLL and ethanol SMILES CCO
checks: File chooser loads the actual FASTA file into the submission
Authenticated submission navigates to its backend-issued run ID
Persisted run completes and displays per-field evidence and abstention states
Leucine composition values are helix-group 1, turn-group 0, sheet-group 1 without coil inference
Zero structural alerts do not become a toxicity assessment
Browser export downloads and equals the persisted artifact with matching hashes
Full reload clears the in-memory token and does not show cached findings
Reauthentication retrieves the same persisted run
Unknown run shows an explicit missing-or-unauthorized state without findings
Legacy clinical-safety route is explicitly disabled
limitations: Local synthetic software fixture only; no scientific predictive evaluation or sensitive-data deployment validation. Manual browser verification is recorded separately from the automated test count.
